card.name: Words leading up to blindness or deafness
card.fires_on: Words just before an expected 'blind', 'blindness' or 'deafness', such as 'become', 'completely', 'total or partial', 'permanent' and 'cause of'. It appears in text about vision or hearing loss.

modes.label: Verbs of becoming
modes.description: Verbs or links that lead into 'blind' or 'blindness' as an outcome.
modes.example: two per cent will<< become>> blind.

modes.label: Degree words
modes.description: Words like completely, total, partial or permanent that come before blind or deafness.
modes.example: typically are<< completely>> blind by their 20s or

modes.label: Links before blindness
modes.description: Small words like 'of' or 'to' that lead into blindness as a cause or end point.
modes.example: the most common cause<< of>> blindness in older Americans?

card.writes: It pushes the model toward degree words such as completely, partial, totally and their Chinese equivalents, which come before a loss like blindness.
card.plain: It fires on the words right before 'blind' or 'deaf' that say how complete or permanent the loss is.
